spans.s: पर्यं(ल्यं)क m. 1. A bed, a sofa; 2. a cloth thrown over the back, loins and kneels, while seated on the hams; 3. sitting upon the hams (a particular posture thus described by Vasiṣṭha- एकं पादमथैकस्मिन् विन्यस्योरौ तु संस्थितम् । इतरस्मिंस्तथैवोरुं वीरासनमुदाहृतम्), K.S.iii.45, 59.
पर्यं(ल्यं)क-बंध m. sitting in the paryanka posture. See पर्यंक (3) above.
पर्यं(ल्यं)क-भोगिन् m. a kind of serpent.
पल (I) m. Straw, husk.
पल (II) n. 1. Flesh, meat; 2. a particular weight equal to four karshas; 3. a particular measure of fluids.
पल्ल m. A large granary.
पाल m. 1. A protector, a guardian, Bt.v.66; 2. a herdsman, विवादः स्वामिपालयोः M.viii.5; 3. a king; 4. a spitting-pot.
पल-अग्नि m. bile.
पल-अंग m. tortoise.
पल-अद, -अशन m. a demon.
पल-अद, -अशन m. a demon.
पलंकट a. bashful, timid.
पलंकर m. bile.
पलंकष m. 1. a goblin; 2. the kiṃśuka tree.
पलंकषा f. a fly.
पल-क्षार m. blood.
पल-गंड m. a plasterer, a mason.
पल-प्रिय m. 1. a demon; 2. a raven.
पल-भा f. the equinoctial shadow at midday.
पलल (I) m. A demon, a goblin.
पलल (II) n. 1. Flesh; 2. mire, mud; 3. a sweetmeat made of ground sesamum and sugar.
पलाल m.n. Straw, husk.
पलल-ज्वर m. bile.
पलल-प्रिय m. 1. a raven; 2. a demon.
पलव m. A kind of net for catching fish.
पल्लव m.n. 1. A sprout, a sprig, a twig, R.i.83, ii.15, iii.7, Am.
; 2. a bud, a blossom; 3. expansion; 4. the red dye called अलक्त q.v.; 5. strength, power; 6. a bracelet, an armlet; 7. love, amorous sport; 8. unsteadiness.
पलांडु m.n. An onion.
पलाप m. 1. The temples of an elephant; 2. a halter.
पलायन n. Running away, flight, escape, Bg.xviii.43, R.xix.31.
पलायित a. (f. ता) Fled, retreated, run away.
पलायित a. (f. ता) Fled, retreated, run away.
पलाल-दोहद m. the mango tree.
पलाली f. A heap of flesh.
पलाश (I) m. Name of a tree otherwise called kiṃśuka, सद्यः स्यूतपलाशपत्रपुटिकापात्रे पवित्रीकृते Sant.S.iv.11.
पलाश (II) n. 1. A leaf, a petal; 2. the blossom of the palāśa tree, बालेंदुवक्राण्यविकाशभावाद्बभुः पलाशान्यतिलोहितानि K.S.iii.29; 3. the green colour.
पालाश (I) a. (f. शी) 1. Belonging to the Palāśa tree; 2. made of the wood of the Palāśa tree, M.ii.45; 3. green.
पालाश (II) m. The green colour.
पलाशिन् m. A tree.
पलिक्नी f. 1. An old grey-haired woman; 2. a cow which has calved for the first time.
पलिघ m. 1. A glass-vessel; 2. a wall, a rampart; 3. a cowpen; 4. an iron club. Cf. परिघ.
पलित (I) a. (f. ता) Grey, hoary, old, aged, तातस्य मे पलितमौलिनिरस्तकाशे (शिरसि) Ve.iii.
पलित (II) n. 1. Hoariness of the hair consequent on old age, R.xii.2, M.vi.2; 2. mud, mire; 3. benzoin; 4. much or ornamented hair.
पलित (I) a. (f. ता) Grey, hoary, old, aged, तातस्य मे पलितमौलिनिरस्तकाशे (शिरसि) Ve.iii.
पालित a. (f. ता) Protected, guarded, preserved.
पालित a. (f. ता) Protected, guarded, preserved.
पलितंकरण m. rendering grey.
पलितंभविष्णु a. becoming grey.
पल्ययन n. 1. A saddle; 2. a rein, a bridle.
पल्लव-अंकुर, -आधार m. a branch.
पल्लव-अंकुर, -आधार m. a branch.
पल्लव-अस्त्र m. an epithet of the god of love.
पल्लव-द्रु m. the aśoka tree.
पल्लवक m. 1. A libertine, the paramour of a harlot; 2. the aśoka tree; 3. a kind of fish.
पल्लविक m. 1. A libertine, a gallant; 2. a catamite.
पल्लवित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Sprouting, having young shoots; 2. extended; 3. dyed red with lac.
पल्लवित (II) m. Lac-dye.
पल्लवित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Sprouting, having young shoots; 2. extended; 3. dyed red with lac.
पल्लविन् a. (f. नी) Having young shoots, K.S.iii.54.
पल्लविन् (II) m. A tree.
पल्लविन् a. (f. नी) Having young shoots, K.S.iii.54.
पल्लि(ल्ली) f. 1. A small village; 2. a hut, a house; 3. a city (at the end of a compound); 4. a house-lizard.
पल्लि(ल्ली) f. 1. A small village; 2. a hut, a house; 3. a city (at the end of a compound); 4. a house-lizard.

पालि(ली) f. 1. The tip of the ear, गुणः श्रवणपालिरिति स्मरेण Git.G.iii.; 2. an edge, a margin; 3. a row, a line; 4. a spot, a mark; 5. maintenance of a scholar by his teacher; 6. a louse; 7. a woman with a beard; 8. praise, eulogium; 9. a particular measure of capacity; 10. the lap, the bosom; 11. the sharp side of anything, Bh.V.ii.3, 10.

पालि(ली) f. 1. The tip of the ear, गुणः श्रवणपालिरिति स्मरेण Git.G.iii.; 2. an edge, a margin; 3. a row, a line; 4. a spot, a mark; 5. maintenance of a scholar by his teacher; 6. a louse; 7. a woman with a beard; 8. praise, eulogium; 9. a particular measure of capacity; 10. the lap, the bosom; 11. the sharp side of anything, Bh.V.ii.3, 10.
पल्लिका f. 1. A small village; 2. a house-lizard.
पालिका f. 1. The tip of the ear; 2. the sharp edge of a cutting instrument; 3. a butter-knife.
पल्वल n. A small pool, a tank, (अल्पं सरः पल्वलं स्यात् Bhāvaprakāśa), R.ii.17, iii.3, Na.i.117.
पाल्वल a. (f. ली) Coming from a pool.
पल्वल-आवास m. a tortoise.
पल्वल-पंक m. the mud of a pool.
पाल-घ्न m. a mushroom.
पालक m. 1. A guardian, a protector; 2. a prince, a sovereign; 3. a groom, a horse-keeper; 4. a horse; 5. the chitraka tree.
पालकाव्य (I) m. Name of a sage, son of Kareṇu, who promulgated the science of elephants.
पालकाव्य (II) n. The science of elephants.
पालंक्य m. 1. A heron; 2. incense.
पालन n. 1. Guarding, protecting, fostering, nourishing, प्रजानां चैव पालनम् M.vii.88, R.xix.3; 2. the milk of a cow that has recently calved.
पालयितृ m. A protector, a guardian, R.ii.60, viii.32.
पालाश (I) a. (f. शी) 1. Belonging to the Palāśa tree; 2. made of the wood of the Palāśa tree, M.ii.45; 3. green.
पालाश-खंड, -षंड m. an epithet of the Magadha country.
पालाश-खंड, -षंड m. an epithet of the Magadha country.
पालित्य n. Greyness of hair consequent on old age.
पाल्वल a. (f. ली) Coming from a pool.
